title: The Long Table
summary: Turning a love of good wine into an invitation for everyone.
cardAlt: The Long Table wine list and table setting
tagline: Good bottles. Open minds. Room for one more.
introduction: A neighbourhood wine bar that makes thoughtful drinking feel generous, sociable, and free from the usual rules.

heroArtwork.alt: Burgundy engraved wine glasses with a curling grapevine.

heroImage.alt: The Long Table wine bottle, cream menu and burgundy matchbox on rose linen.

challenge.heading: Serious wine without the serious atmosphere.
challenge.copy: The founders knew exactly how they wanted the room to feel: informed but never intimidating, lively but never rushed. They needed a brand that could signal expertise while keeping the invitation wide open.

contribution.heading: A wine identity built around gathering.
contribution.copy: We positioned the bar around the shared table, using an expressive editorial identity, conversational menus, and a warm visual rhythm that makes discovery feel social rather than instructional.

image.alt: The Long Table cream wine list, burgundy matchbox and printed coasters.

brandPanel.title: The Long Table
brandPanel.statement: Bring a bottle. Bring a story. Stay a while.
brandPanel.label: Neighbourhood wine bar

image.alt: The Long Table burgundy matchbox and cream wine menu beside a wine glass.
The Long Table wine bar with a communal timber table and candlelit seating.

outcome.heading: A wine bar that speaks like a good host.
outcome.copy: The Long Table now has a confident voice and a flexible identity that helps guests feel curious rather than cautious, turning every menu, sign, and invitation into a reason to pull up a chair.
